item.title: AI and Writing: Academic Integrity and Your Voice
item.description: Wednesday, October 14th, 2026: 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM Student Success Center, Folsom Library, 1st Floor In the age of AI, it is increasingly important to understand how AI can serve as an effective tool in the writing process, and what it means to use it with academic integrity. This workshop explores how to use AI effectively and responsibly while maintaining your own voice as a writer.

item.title: Planning Ahead: iClicker Support Concludes January 2027
item.description: iClicker will no longer be a supported campus tool as of January 2027 starting in the spring term. For those that may still be using iClicker, we recommend using Slido which is currently the supported polling tool on campus.

item.title: DSES PhD Candidate John Nichols Receives U.S. Coast Guard Patches in Recognition of Research
item.description: John Nichols, Decision Sciences and Engineering Systems PhD candidate ’28, received the US Coast Guard Sector Western Alaska & US Arctic patches, presented by Prof Martha Grabowski, for assisting the US Coast Guard with modeling prioritized inspection schedules for Arctic bulk fuel facilities. Congratulations, John, and thank you to Shawn Hay (USCG Arctic Coordinator) and LT Brett Woodward, (USCG Sector Western Alaska and U.S. Arctic) who provided the patches!

item.title: Entrepreneur of the Year Award Celebration and Pitch Event
item.description: October 21, 2026 - 1:00pm - Entrepreneur of the Year Award celebration. Innovation is a significant part of RPI’s storied past. The award recognizes successful entrepreneurs whose vision, commitment, and creativity exemplify the entrepreneurial spirit that is the past, present, and future of RPI. This year’s honoree is Ajit Prabhu ’98, the founder of Quest Global. The awards ceremony, fireside chat with President Schmidt, and an RPI startup pitch competition will be held in the EMPAC theater.
item.author: Community

item.title: A Lifted Lamp - Albany Pro Musica with RPI Concert Choir
item.description: The RPI Concert Choir is honored to join Albany Pro Musica on October 18, for A Lifted Lamp, a powerful concert celebrating the voices, stories, and enduring spirit of the American experience. Inspired by Emma Lazarus’s iconic poem The New Colossus, whose words welcome the world at the Statue of Liberty, the program explores themes of hope, belonging, resilience, and the promise of a better future through an inspiring collection of choral works. Starts at 3pm at Troy Savings Bank Music Hall.

item.title: RPI Libraries now requires accessing Elsevier databases through your RCS ID
item.description: Going forward, please use your RCS ID to access the following databases, even while on campus: ScienceDirect, Scopus, Engineering Village (Compendex & INSPEC), Knovel, and LeapSpace. Installing LibKey Nomad can help make this transition seamless.
